source_prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting failed advertised specifications in a consumer product performance report

1. Start with the test records.
2.
completion:
Record all products for which all test results are in the specifications.
3. Record all products for which not all test results are in the specifications.
4. Find the product with the greatest number of test failures.
5. Set the number of failures of that product to be 100.
6. Recalculate all other test failures to be a percent of the greatest number of test failures.
7. Record the percentage of test failures in the performance report.
8. Document all test failures in the performance report.
